request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER

layers.text: Turn the toffee cube into a liquorice allsort sweet: the cube becomes a square sandwich of three thick flat layers, black liquorice #23192b, on top and at the bottom, and one bright white sugar layer in the middle with the face on it; the wrapper wings become bright pink #ff8fc0, and white stripes; the knob, the feet and the shield are black liquorice. No toffee gold is left. Keep the face, the lollipop, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
